set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Day-based puzzle
set.stimulus:
Seven persons — M, N, O, P, Q, R and S — go to a gym on different days of the same week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday. Only one person goes on each day. Each of them is from a different city — Kochi, Lucknow, Shimla, Kolkata, Ranchi, Bhopal and Mumbai.

1. Only one person goes between the one who is from Shimla and P.
2. Only three persons go between Q and N, and Q goes after N.
3. Only one person goes between the one who is from Kolkata and the one who is from Bhopal.
4. Only one person goes between the one who is from Shimla and R, and the one who is from Shimla goes after R.
5. More than four persons go after M.
6. Less than five persons go between Q and the one who is from Shimla.
7. Only one person goes between O and M, and O goes after M.
8. As many persons go before the one who is from Ranchi as after N.
9. O is from Kolkata.
10. Only five persons go after the one who is from Mumbai.
11. More than two persons go between the one who is from Kochi and P.
